comparison.objective: Thread shock cord through a spring cord lock while holding its release button.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually maintain button depression while feeding flexible cord through a constrained passage.
comparison.success_condition: Cord passes through with at least 40 mm on each side; spring grips it; lock rests on table; hands clear and system still.
comparison.reason: This is a bimanual feed-through neighbor, but it tests flexible threading through an opened clamp. The candidate tests rigid block sliding across a mated support boundary with free-ball containment and gap/inclination sensitivity.
